An FT-Transformer (feature tokenizer with categorical embeddings and continuous projection, CLS token, positional encoding, nn.TransformerEncoder encoder, MLP head) is trained with label-smoothed BCE-with-logits, AdamW, warmup+cosine LR schedule, gradient clipping, and optional mixup augmentation. Training runs 5-fold StratifiedKFold CV with early stopping, OOF threshold search, then refits on all rows; artifacts (config.json with FE state, feature columns, cat/cont splits, cards, cont stats, label values, threshold, and model.pt) are persisted, and predict reloads them in a new process for inference and original-label mapping. The approach is methodologically sound but the model/CV budget exceeds the host's CPU time limit."}
message.reasoning_content:
The execution failed with exit code 152, which is likely a timeout (SIGXCPU) or memory kill. Exit status 152 typically means killed by signal 24 (SIGXCPU) - 128+24=152. So the training exceeded the 600s time limit. This is a bug/resource failure.

Actually 152 = 128 + 24 = SIGXCPU (CPU time limit exceeded). So the candidate train timed out.
